SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN entry_type = 'NORMAL' THEN amount WHEN entry_type = 'REVERSE' THEN -amount ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM finance_write_off WHERE target_type = #{targetType} AND target_id = #{targetId} AND deleted = FALSE

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO finance_write_off (write_off_no, source_type, source_id, target_type, target_id, amount, entry_type, reverse_of_id, reason, written_off_at, operator, version, deleted, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{writeOffNo}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{amount}, #{entryType}, #{reverseOfId}, #{reason}, #{writtenOffAt}, #{operator}, 0, FALSE, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}) ON CONFLICT (reverse_of_id) WHERE deleted = FALSE AND entry_type = 'REVERSE' DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO finance_write_off (write_off_no, source_type, source_id, target_type, target_id, amount, entry_type, reverse_of_id, reason, written_off_at, operator, version, deleted, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{writeOffNo}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{amount}, #{entryType}, #{reverseOfId}, #{reason}, #{writtenOffAt}, #{operator}, 0, FALSE, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}) ON CONFLICT (source_type, source_id) WHERE entry_type = 'NORMAL' AND source_type = 'BALANCE_MOVEMENT' DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM finance_write_off WHERE reverse_of_id = #{writeOffId} AND entry_type = 'REVERSE' AND deleted = FALSE)
mapper.sql: SELECT wo.id AS writeOffId, wo.write_off_no AS writeOffNo, wo.source_type AS sourceType, wo.source_id AS sourceId, COALESCE(r.receipt_no, p.payment_no, m.movement_no) AS sourceNo, COALESCE(r.customer_name_snapshot, p.counterparty_name_snapshot, mc.name) AS sourceName, wo.target_type AS targetType, wo.target_id AS targetId, COALESCE(ar.receivable_no, ap.payable_no) AS targetNo, COALESCE(ar.customer_name_snapshot, ap.supplier_name_snapshot) AS targetName, wo.amount, wo.entry_type AS entryType, wo.reverse_of_id AS reverseOfId, wo.reason, wo.written_off_at AS writtenOffAt, wo.operator FROM finance_write_off wo LEFT JOIN finance_receipt r ON wo.source_type = 'RECEIPT' AND r.id = wo.source_id AND r.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN finance_payment p ON wo.source_type = 'PAYMENT' AND p.id = wo.source_id AND p.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN customer_balance_movement m ON wo.source_type = 'BALANCE_MOVEMENT' AND m.id = wo.source_id AND m.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN customer mc ON mc.id = m.customer_id AND mc.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN finance_receivable ar ON wo.target_type = 'RECEIVABLE' AND ar.id = wo.target_id AND ar.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN sales_order so ON ar.order_id = so.id AND so.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN finance_payable ap ON wo.target_type = 'PAYABLE' AND ap.id = wo.target_id AND ap.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN purchase_receipt pr ON pr.id = ap.source_id AND pr.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN purchase_order po ON po.id = pr.purchase_order_id AND po.deleted = FALSE
